read.thesis: Q3 FY27 revenue $115.8B (+103% y/y) beat the $108B guide, but Q4 guide of $130B and 71-72% GM show strong demand with receivables ballooning to $81.0B versus $38.5B a year ago.

capex.peers_comment: Announced plans with Amkor, IBIDEN, King Yuan, Samsung Electro-Mechanics, SPIL and Unimicron to scale critical manufacturing capabilities.
capex.quote: Announced plans with global supply chain partners, including Amkor Technology, IBIDEN, King Yuan Electronics, Samsung Electro-Mechanics, Siliconware Precision Industries and Unimicron Technology Corporation, to scale critical manufacturing capabilities to meet demand for NVIDIA infrastructure.

triggers.label: Q4 revenue guide $130B ±3%
triggers.quote: Revenue is expected to be $130.0 billion, plus or minus 3%.

triggers.quote: to scale critical manufacturing capabilities to meet demand for NVIDIA infrastructure.

triggers.label: Q3 data center revenue up 110% y/y
triggers.quote: Data Center revenue of $107.6 billion, up 110% from a year ago.

guidance.quote: Revenue is expected to be $130.0 billion, plus or minus 3%.

non-GAAP operating expenses are expected to be approximately $11.0 billion and $10.7 billion, respectively.
